subject.title: fix(sqlite): stop mount probes blocking database startup

question: Should SQLite database opening be allowed to synchronously wait on the system `mount` process at all, or must mount metadata be prepared and cached before stores open?
rationale: The patch improves the common timeout case, but only the SQLite owner can accept the remaining startup-blocking and journal-mode compatibility boundary; repository policy favors carrying process-stable prepared facts into hot paths.

options.title: Move probing off database open
options.body: Prepare one asynchronous process-scoped mount snapshot before stores open and use conservative rollback mode when that snapshot is unavailable.

options.title: Accept the synchronous fallback
options.body: Explicitly own the possibility of a child that outlives the timeout and require supported-host proof of aggregate multi-database startup and journal selection before merge.

recommendation.title: Move probing off database open
recommendation.body: Prepare one asynchronous process-scoped mount snapshot before stores open and use conservative rollback mode when that snapshot is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the current branch's repeated SQLite implementation refinements, so they are best positioned to decide the startup boundary.
